svg.title: Finance: procure to pay
svg.desc: The requester submits a requisition. The manager approves or rejects it. Finance routes requests above the threshold to the CFO, then issues a purchase order to the vendor. The vendor delivers and invoices. Finance performs a three-way match of order, receipt and invoice; a mismatch is disputed with the vendor, and a match is paid.
svg.text: A requisition is approved by the budget owner, escalated to the CFO above a threshold, ordered, matched and paid.
Illustrative process. Lanes are roles; steps, thresholds and timings are examples, not policy.
